# ClassDojo

> ClassDojo is a K-12 school communication and engagement platform used in over 90% of U.S. schools and 160+ countries. It combines classroom communication, family engagement, and positive behavior support (PBIS) in one system. Free for teachers, schools, and districts. Funded by ~5% of families who purchase optional premium features (ClassDojo Plus).

ClassDojo serves four audiences: teachers, families, school leaders, and district administrators. The core platform is free and includes two-way messaging, behavior points, class stories (photo/video sharing), a classroom toolkit (timer, noise meter, group maker, random picker), and an AI teaching assistant (Sidekick). All messages are automatically translated into 180+ languages.

Additional products include ClassDojo Plus (premium family subscription with homework help, 1,000+ books, and behavior feedback at home), Dojo Islands (safe collaborative virtual world for ages 5-10), Dojo Tutor (1-on-1 online tutoring), Dojo Sparks (AI-powered early reading coach for ages 3-8), and Big Ideas (social-emotional learning content created with Stanford's PERTS Research Center).

For districts, ClassDojo provides multi-channel announcements (app, email, SMS, voice), family engagement analytics, PBIS-aligned behavior management, SIS rostering, SSO integration (Google/Microsoft), district leader portal with audit logs, and CSAM/keyword scanning. The platform is COPPA, FERPA, and GDPR compliant, with a 93% Common Sense Media privacy rating. Student data is never sold or monetized.

Pricing: Free for all teachers, schools, and district partners. ClassDojo Plus is an optional paid subscription for families. Districts are never charged for the software.

## Pages for Teachers

- [Teachers](https://www.classdojo.com/teachers): Main teacher landing page with feature overview
- [Teacher Signup](https://www.classdojo.com/teacher-signup): Create a free teacher account
- [Classroom Management](https://www.classdojo.com/classroom-management): Classroom management tools overview
- [Behavior Points](https://www.classdojo.com/points): Behavior points system
- [Class Story](https://www.classdojo.com/classstory): Photo and video sharing with families
- [Toolkit](https://www.classdojo.com/toolkit): Free classroom tools (timer, noise meter, etc.)
- [Toolkit Timer](https://www.classdojo.com/toolkit/timer): Classroom timer
- [Toolkit Noise Meter](https://www.classdojo.com/toolkit/noisemeter): Noise meter tool
- [Toolkit Random Picker](https://www.classdojo.com/toolkit/random): Random student picker
- [Toolkit Group Maker](https://www.classdojo.com/toolkit/groupmaker): Group maker tool
- [Toolkit Music](https://www.classdojo.com/toolkit/music): Background music for class
- [Toolkit Directions](https://www.classdojo.com/toolkit/directions): Directions display
- [Training](https://www.classdojo.com/training): Teacher training resources
- [Resources](https://www.classdojo.com/resources): Educational resources and downloads
- [Mentors](https://www.classdojo.com/mentors): ClassDojo Mentors ambassador program

## Pages for Families

- [Families](https://www.classdojo.com/families): Main family landing page
- [Download](https://www.classdojo.com/download): Download the ClassDojo app (iOS/Android)
- [Beyond School](https://www.classdojo.com/beyondschool): Learning at home features
- [ClassDojo Plus](https://www.classdojo.com/plus): Premium family subscription
- [Dojo Islands](https://www.classdojo.com/dojo-islands): Safe collaborative virtual world for kids
- [Mindfulness](https://ideas.classdojo.com/b/mindfulness/): Mindfulness content for kids
- [Conundrums](https://ideas.classdojo.com/b/conundrums/): Discussion activities for kids

## Pages for Schools

- [Schools](https://www.classdojo.com/schools): Main page for school leaders
- [Schoolwide Points](https://www.classdojo.com/schoolwide-points): Schoolwide PBIS points system
- [PBIS](https://www.classdojo.com/pbis): PBIS implementation guide
- [School Community](https://www.classdojo.com/school-community): Building school community
- [Staff Messaging](https://www.classdojo.com/staff-messaging): Staff communication tools

## Pages for Districts

- [Districts](https://www.classdojo.com/districts): Main districts landing page and demo request
- [All Solutions](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/solutions): Overview of district solutions
- [Communication](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/solutions/communication): Unified K-12 communication
- [Family Engagement](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/solutions/family-engagement): Family engagement tools
- [Behavior Management](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/solutions/behavior-management): PBIS and behavior management
- [Classroom Management](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/solutions/classroom-management): Classroom tools at scale
- [Oversight & Control](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/solutions/oversight-and-control): Admin oversight and compliance
- [Solutions by Role](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/roles): District solutions organized by role
- [For Superintendents](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/roles/super): Superintendent-focused solutions
- [For Comms Leaders](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/roles/comms): Communication leader solutions
- [For Tech Leaders](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/roles/tech): Technology leader solutions
- [For Instructional Leaders](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/roles/instructional): Instructional leader solutions
- [Customer Stories](https://www.classdojo.com/districts/customer-stories): District success stories

## Company & Support

- [About](https://www.classdojo.com/about): About ClassDojo
- [Mission](https://www.classdojo.com/mission): Company mission
- [Jobs](https://www.classdojo.com/jobs): Careers at ClassDojo
- [Press](https://www.classdojo.com/press): Press room
- [Privacy & Security](https://www.classdojo.com/privacy-and-security): Privacy and security center
- [Transparency](https://www.classdojo.com/transparency): Data transparency
- [Accessibility](https://www.classdojo.com/accessibility): Accessibility statement
- [Contact](https://www.classdojo.com/contact): Contact form
- [Help Center](https://help.classdojo.com): Help center and support documentation
- [Privacy Email](mailto:privacy@classdojo.com): Privacy questions

## Related Sites

- [Blog](https://blog.classdojo.com): Company blog
- [Engineering Blog](https://engineering.classdojo.com): Engineering blog
- [Big Ideas](https://ideas.classdojo.com): SEL content library
- [Teacher App](https://teach.classdojo.com): Teacher web app
- [Family App](https://home.classdojo.com): Parent/family web app
- [Student App](https://student.classdojo.com): Student web app
- [Dojo Tutor](https://tutor.classdojo.com): Dojo Tutor tutoring platform

## Optional

Mission and values: ClassDojo's mission is to give every kid on Earth an education they love. Core values are privacy-first (no advertising, no data selling, COPPA/FERPA compliant), equity in communication (instant translation in 180+ languages), positive behavior reinforcement (research-backed, PBIS-aligned), and simplicity (easy for teachers, engaging for families, motivating for students).

Core platform features for teachers (free):

- Class Management: create classes, add students, manage rosters
- Messaging: two-way communication with families, both individual and group
- Behavior Points: award positive and negative points aligned to classroom values
- Class Story: share photos, videos, and updates with families
- Student Portfolios: students can share their work with families
- Classroom Toolkit: timer, noise meter, random student picker, group maker, background music, directions display
- Reports: track behavior trends and engagement over time
- Sidekick AI: AI teaching assistant that drafts family messages, generates report card comments, creates behavior intervention plans, generates lesson plans and activities, and creates multiple-choice questions

Core platform features for families (free):

- Real-time Updates: insight into child's class activity as it happens
- Messaging: communicate directly with teachers
- Photos & Videos: view Class Story posts from the classroom
- Instant Translation: all content automatically translated in 190+ languages
- Multiple Children: manage all kids in one account

Core platform features for school leaders (free):

- Schoolwide Points: consistent PBIS implementation across the entire school
- School Story: share updates with all families at once
- Staff Directory: manage teacher accounts
- Analytics: school-level engagement and behavior reports

ClassDojo Plus (paid family subscription):

- AI-powered homework help
- Positive behavior feedback at home
- 1,000+ interactive books
- Enhanced avatar customization
- Unlimited access to Big Ideas video series
- Family activity content

Dojo Islands: a safe, collaborative virtual world where kids ages 5-10 play, create, and learn together. No free chat — communication is limited to emoji and preset messages only, reducing risk of inappropriate language. Content is age-appropriate by design. Teacher- and parent-controlled — educators manage the environment and parents can turn off access at any time. Kids build maps, create worlds, and invent games collaboratively, strengthening real social connections. Similar to popular games but purpose-built to be safe for younger kids and school communities.

Dojo Sparks: an AI-powered early reading coach for ages 3-8 that listens as kids read aloud, giving real-time feedback and encouragement. Uses phonics-first, research-backed instruction that helps kids connect letters to sounds, blend sounds, and read words and sentences. Adaptive voice technology hears how children pronounce letters and words. Progresses naturally from ABCs to full reading fluency. Sessions are short (~15 minutes), designed for daily use without adult setup. Kids speak, trace, blend, match, and write their way through lessons. Game-like experience with encouragement-focused feedback that builds confidence alongside skills.

Dojo Tutor: 1-on-1 online tutoring with certified, experienced tutors. Covers math, reading, and other core subjects. Flexible scheduling and personalized learning plans. Trusted by 100,000+ families.

Big Ideas (SEL Content): social-emotional learning content created with Stanford's PERTS Research Center. Covers growth mindset, empathy, and perseverance. Includes video series with accompanying classroom activities. Age-appropriate content for K-8 students.

District solutions — Communication & Announcements:

- Multi-channel announcements: send one message across app, email, SMS, and automated voice — no duplicate work, no missed families
- Built for K-12: one platform for Pre-K through high school, eliminating the need for multiple tools
- District, school, and class-level announcements: one-way broadcasting at every level with centralized oversight
- Urgent alerts: priority SMS notifications with read visibility for emergencies, closures, or time-sensitive updates
- Two-way messaging: secure teacher-family conversations with 80%+ same-day read rates
- Teacher-student messaging: safe, family-visible messaging for grades 6-12
- Instant translation: every message, post, and alert translated into 180+ languages automatically
- Scheduled communications: write now, send later — schedule and automate posts across schools and channels
- Social media integration: auto-share district announcements to Facebook and Instagram pages
- District calendar: centralized event hub with signups, reminders, and recurring events

District solutions — Family Engagement:

- Class and school stories: real-time photos and videos from classrooms and schools
- Walk the Halls: see positive moments happening across every school in real time
- Multi-channel reach: app, email, SMS, and voice — reach families where they are
- Reachability dashboard: see which families are reachable and on which channel
- Engagement analytics: read and open rates per channel, with filtering for unread or unreachable families
- Automated attendance alerts: SIS-triggered notifications when students are absent
- Events and sign-ups: volunteer coordination, RSVPs, and family nights

District solutions — Behavior Management (PBIS-Aligned):

- Districtwide points system: align recognition to district, school, or classroom values
- Behavior dashboard: spot trends and track recognition across schools
- Behavior visibility for families: parents see real-time points, goals, and progress
- Any staff can award points: recognition in classrooms, hallways, lunchrooms, or playgrounds
- Student rewards: built-in points redemption system
- Big Ideas SEL content: growth mindset lessons to support positive behavior
- PBIS and MTSS compatible: fully aligned with existing behavior frameworks

District solutions — Middle School and High School Features (new in 2026):

- Teen accounts: private, student-facing views for middle and high school students
- Teacher-student messaging: direct messaging for grades 6-12 with family visibility
- SSO-secured student access: secure login with district oversight
- Age-appropriate interface: designed for older students, including custom avatars

District solutions — Oversight & Control:

- District Leader Portal: admin access across every school with role-based permissions
- Message & Audit Log: searchable by user or timeframe, exportable for compliance
- CSAM & Keyword Scanning: AI scanning for harmful text and images
- Message Downloads: quickly review or export flagged messages
- Compliance Ready: COPPA, FERPA, GDPR (Europe), ADA compliant
- Data Privacy: 93% Common Sense Media privacy rating, no data monetization

District solutions — IT & Security:

- SSO Integration: Google and Microsoft single sign-on
- SIS Rostering: nightly sync of teachers, students, parents, classes, and enrollments
- Flexible Setup: SIS direct, Classlink, or SFTP
- MFA Support: multi-factor authentication
- Centralized Deactivation: instant staff account management
- Data Hygiene Dashboard: view and manage invalid contact data
- WCAG 2.2 Accessible: screen reader support, high contrast, keyboard navigation

District solutions — Classroom Management Tools:

- Attendance Tracking: built-in attendance with SIS integration
- Student Portfolios: students share their work with families
- Timer & Noise Meter: classroom management tools
- Group Maker & Random Picker: student organization tools
- Sidekick AI: AI assistant for teachers (messages, lesson plans, report cards)
- Ready-made Activities: pre-built classroom activities
- Dojo Islands: play-based learning for classroom use

District solutions — Reporting & Analytics:

- Engagement Dashboard: real-time insights on who's receiving and reading messages
- School-level Data: detailed insights by school, grade, or message
- Reachability Reports: identify disconnected families and follow up
- Behavior Dashboard: track recognition and trends across every school
- Usage Analytics: monitor adoption and engagement across district

District solutions — Implementation & Support:

- Easy setup with step-by-step guide for rollout
- Custom professional development for school leaders and teachers
- Dedicated account manager for personalized strategy and coaching
- White-glove support with expert guidance throughout implementation

District value by role — For Superintendents: Walk the Halls provides a live feed of positive moments from every school for real-time visibility into school culture. Reachability & Engagement Dashboard monitors connection across the community. One unified K-12 platform reinforces a cohesive district culture. Automatic 190+ language translation ensures every family is included.

District value by role — For Communication Leaders: draft once, send everywhere across email, SMS, app, and automated voice calls. Urgent SMS alerts with read receipts for critical updates. Auto-post announcements to Facebook and Instagram. Reachability Reports identify invalid contact info for database cleanup.

District value by role — For Technology Leaders (CTOs/CIOs): consolidate 3-5 fragmented tools (messaging, PBIS trackers, translation, robocalls) into one platform. District Leader Portal with granular role-based permissions and audit logs. SOC 2, FERPA/COPPA compliant, iKeepSafe certified, with CSAM and keyword scanning. Automated SIS rostering (daily sync) and SSO (Google/Microsoft) for zero manual account management.

District value by role — For Instructional Leaders (CAOs): Sidekick AI automates administrative tasks, giving teachers more time for instruction. Districtwide PBIS dashboards track behavior trends and align incentives with district values. Automated attendance nudges reduce chronic absenteeism. Teacher-student messaging for middle and high school builds student agency with family visibility.

District case studies: Spring ISD, Texas (43 schools, 34,000 students) saved $120,000 per year by consolidating communication tools. Moline-Coal Valley, Illinois (13 schools, 7,500 students) doubled family engagement after implementation. Miami-Dade County Public Schools, one of the largest districts in the U.S., chose ClassDojo for consistent two-way family engagement at scale.

Impact data: 80% of messages are read the same day. 89% of district staff report ClassDojo helps build stronger family relationships. 3 in 4 principals say it helps build positive behavior. 1 in 3 teachers say it improves attendance. 8 in 10 teachers say it improves their day-to-day. 1 in 2 teachers say it keeps kids more engaged. 69% of families want daily or weekly updates on their child's progress.

Privacy and security certifications: Student Privacy Pledge (early signatory), CISA K-12 Secure by Design participant, iKeepSafe Safe Harbor certified, COPPA certified, FERPA compliant, GDPR compliant, 93% Common Sense Media privacy rating, ADA and WCAG 2.2 accessible. No advertising. Student data never sold or monetized.

URL patterns: most pages follow classdojo.com/{page-name}. Localized pages use classdojo.com/{locale}/{page-name}. Supported locales include en-us, es-es, pt-br, fr-fr, de-de, and others.

_Last updated: March 2026. For the most current information, visit [classdojo.com](https://www.classdojo.com)._
